triples.head_surface: Fuel oil transfer pumps, fuel oil unit pumps and other similar fuel pumps, lubricating oil service pumps, thermal oil circulating pumps and oil separators
triples.head_canonical_zh: 燃油及润滑油泵与分离器
triples.evidence_text: Fuel oil transfer pumps, fuel oil unit pumps and other similar fuel pumps, lubricating oil service pumps, thermal oil circulating pumps and oil separators (purifiers, but not including oily water separators) are to be fitted with remote means of stopping.

triples.tail_surface: located outside the space where these pumps and separators are installed or at the firefighting station
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 布置在泵舱外或消防站
triples.evidence_text: These means are to be located outside the space where these pumps and separators are installed or at the firefighting station, if fitted, so that they may be stopped in the event of a fire arising in that space.
